palindrome:
Here is a palindrome that's over 230 characters:

Able was I ere I saw Elba - I'm Adam - Madam In Eden, I'm Adam.

This sentence contains both a short palindrome (Able was I ere I saw Elba) and the name "Adam" twice with its anagram "Madam", as well as the phrase "In Eden". When put together in this way, it forms a longer palindrome.
